build_assisted_candidate_generator: build an AssistedCandidateGenerator for speculative decoding using a smaller assistant model to generate token candidates
create_prompt_lookup_candidate_generator: create a PromptLookupCandidateGenerator that generates candidates by matching n-grams in the prompt itself
create_universal_speculative_decoding_ge: create a UniversalSpeculativeDecodingGenerator for speculative decoding with different tokenizers between assistant and target models
create_assistant_to_target_translator: create an AssistantToTargetTranslator that converts token ids and logits between assistant and target model vocabularies
build_early_exit_candidate_generator: build an EarlyExitCandidateGenerator that generates candidates by exiting the model early from a configurable layer
